firmographics.narrative_md:
Wescom Central Credit Union, operating as Wescom Financial since its 2025 rebrand, was chartered in 1934 as a federal credit union (NCUA charter #66703). The institution maintains two wholly-owned subsidiaries: Wescom Resources Group LLC, a Credit Union Service Organization (CUSO) providing technology services to 120+ credit unions and financial institutions nationwide, and Wescom Financial Services LLC. Headquartered at 123 South Marengo Avenue, Pasadena, California 91101, the credit union is led by CEO Darren Williams, who has served for 28+ years and was named to the Los Angeles Business Journal’s LA500 list in 2025. [E-001, E-002, E-003, E-004]

The 2025 rebrand from “Wescom Credit Union” to “Wescom Financial” with the “Bank Better” tagline signals strategic intent to position as a full-service financial institution competing beyond traditional credit union boundaries. This positioning is supported by the May 2025 LPL Financial wealth management partnership, the UCLA affinity relationship ($38M, 10-year contract), and EVERFI financial education modules (25 adult + 14 youth courses). [E-003, E-037, E-047]
